name: enigma-lab
description: Educational Enigma I, M3 and M4 simulator with monthly codebooks

scripts.build: pnpm build:standalone && pnpm --filter './packages/**' build && pnpm --filter @enigma/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @enigma/core build && pnpm --filter @enigma/shared build && pnpm --filter @enigma/codebook-core typecheck && pnpm --filter @enigma/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @enigma/core test && pnpm --filter @enigma/core build && pnpm --filter @enigma/codebook-core test && pnpm --filter @enigma/shared test
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
